summary: Zeo Energy Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a Note Purchase Agreement with White Lion Capital, LLC for up to $7.5M in unsecured convertible promissory notes. The first closing on June 9, 2026, issued a $1.67M note with $1.5M gross proceeds (10% OID). Notes mature in 24 months, bear 5% interest, and are convertible at a price equal to the greater of $0.50 or 95% of the 5-day VWAP. Additional closings up to $6M may occur through June 9, 2027. This is a structured equity line, not a special situation; watch for potential dilution from conversions at variable prices.
